messages:
kevin: Heads up — planning to flip speculative-decoding ON for 5% of prod sessions in eu-west for 2h tomorrow at 10:00 UTC. Need quick thumbs on guardrails and any objections.
maria: +1 for the experiment. request: add `latency_slo_ms: 250` and auto-fallback to baseline if p99 > 400ms for any model.
sam: Also check KV cache behavior — speculative decoding can increase KV churn. Can we scope to requests with empty kv-cache first?
aisha: Agree with Maria. Suggest audience: `rollout:5%|eu-west|kv-empty` so we minimize cache interference.
kevin: good call. plan change: audience -> `5% eu-west with kv-empty` and fallback policy `p99>400ms -> disable spec-decoding for affected worker`.
henry: Also add a kernel-guardrail: if flash-attn kernel fails (OOM or bad perf), swap to non-flash path and mark node unhealthy for 5m. Can we add that as part of the rollout? short snippet:
```
kernel_fallback:
  flash_attn: on_error -> legacy_attn; mark_unhealthy: 300
```

maria: LGTM. ops note: require a canary tag so SRE can isolate traces `/trace?tag=spec-decay-canary`.
kevin: I'll open the rollout config PR in a minute. @deploy-bot can you schedule the flip at 2026-03-18T10:00:00Z and notify #eng-oncall 15m prior?
deploy-bot: scheduled toggle `spec-decoding` -> ON for audience `5%|eu-west|kv-empty` at 2026-03-18T10:00:00Z. Reminder to eng-oncall in 15m.
aisha: Quick QA checklist: 1) verify trace tag present, 2) ensure kv-empty audience actually routes (test user ids), 3) ensure fallback logs with reason codes.
sam: I'll run the small perf harness against the canary config (1000 requests) and paste results here before flip.
kevin: thanks — will post PR link and release notes once created. If no objections by EOD today we proceed.
